genesis_semantics: authorize qualified canonical state as genesis of a new ledger; never represent pre-genesis operations as events
authorizing_role: QUALIFICATION_AUTHORITY or Architect with explicit genesis permission

persistence_bundle_contract.trusted: qualified state + explicit authority + immutable binding

idempotence: same request returns same lineage; conflicting request fails
fork_control: one genesis per snapshot/scope/lineage; distinct lineage requires distinct explicit authority
invalidation: invalid source/authority/scope/lineage invalidates genesis, bundle and descendants
replay: bundle genesis reproduces source state without pre-genesis history
cold_restore: state, ledger, genesis, head, trust and provenance recover exactly
runtime_capability: begin_event_lineage(snapshot, genesis_authority, scope, lineage) -> trusted PersistenceBundle

human_decision.subject: Authorize new trusted event lineage from qualified E2 state
human_decision.authorize: permits one bounded E2 genesis; does not attest evidence
human_decision.decline: no bundle/genesis; T01-B and P03 remain blocked
